Name: Allow Beach Sprinklers
Author: Jag3dagster
Description:
[b]AllowBeachSprinklers[/b] is an open-source mod for [url=https://stardewvalley.net/]Stardew Valley[/url] that allows players to utilize sprinklers in the Beach farm map that was introduced in version 1.5.

[size=4][b][u]Documentation[/u][/b][/size]
[size=3][u]Overview[/u]
[/size]This mod programmatically removes the restriction of not being able to place / use sprinklers on the Beach Farm tiles.
[list]
[*]This mod works for both existing and newly created Beach Farms
[/list]
[u][size=3]Install[/size][/u][list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][list=1][*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Nexus Mirror[/url]
[*][url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]GitHub Mirror[/url]
[/list]
[*]Install this mod by unzipping the mod folder into 'Stardew Valley/Mods'
[*]Launch the game using SMAPI
[/list]
[size=3][u]Compatibility[/u][/size][list]
[*]Compatible with...[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later
[/list]
[*]No known mod conflicts[list]
[*]If you find one please feel free to notify me here or on [url=https://github.com/Hedgehog-Technologies/StardewMods]GitHub[/url]﻿﻿
[/list]
[/list]
[size=4][b][u]Limitations[/u][/b][/size]
[u][size=3]Multiplayer[/size][/u][list]
[*]Host must have this mod installed for this to mod to work for any players in their game[list]
[*]If the host [i]does not[/i] have it installed then the animation may still play, but plants will not be considered 'watered'
[/list]
[*]Any additional player that would like to be able to place sprinklers will also need to install this mod
[/list]
[u][size=3]Solo + Multiplayer[/size][/u][list]
[*]Players will need to keep this this mod installed for sprinklers to continue to water adjacent tiles as expected[list]
[*]If mod is uninstalled, placed sprinklers will remain and animations will continue to run, however, the expected adjacent tiles will not be considered 'watered'
[/list]
[/list]
[size=4][b][u]Releases[/u][/b][/size]
Releases can be found [url=https://github.com/Hedgehog-Technologies/StardewMods/releases]on GitHub[/url] and on the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7629]Nexus Mod[/url] site.
